name: app-happy-halloween-phone-mockup-on-3d-pumpkin-podiums-with-balloons
title: 'Happy Halloween' phone mockup on a 3D podium flanked by pumpkins, gift boxes and balloon clusters
whatItIs: A purple-blue 3D scene with a phone mockup on a rounded podium at centre, flanked by two lower podiums holding jack-o'-lanterns, a gift box, a candle and a witch-hat pumpkin, with black, orange and purple balloon clusters and a script 'Happy Halloween' title.
whatItMeans: Festive and premium; a full 3D staged scene turns a simple app mockup into a seasonal retail moment.
techniques: Stage a device mockup on a multi-level 3D podium display.
Flank the hero podium with themed props at lower levels.
Use balloon clusters to add colour and festivity.

vocabulary.definition: A staged 3D scene using pedestals of different heights.
Arranging themed objects around a hero subject for context.
